notes: Flagged fusion `הֲדֹם רַגְלָיו` → *footstool* retained: the compound English word writes both lexemes, so no morpheme may be marked unrepresented (rule 30). Because both lexemes stand inside the one word, neither noun carries content the other lacks and rule 23's tie sends the head to the governing construct `הֲדֹם` — the opposite outcome from PSA.132.3, where the single word writes one lexeme alone.
The suffix on `רַגְלָיו` is no part of the fusion and takes the possessive written for it (rules 30 and 18).
